paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Mansia, a Tanna, Chagigah 9a.

notes.text: י.. gives Berakhot 10a by the period convention with terminal stop; ט. gives Chagigah 9a, whose period may also be line punctuation. Neither locus is independently checked against a named edition. The numerals are present in the running English, not only reference candidates.

The final In the Mishnah follows and contextually qualifies Shimon’s citation, while its own source-unit boundary is preserved. Tanna is an explicit classification; Mansia vowels are conventional. Yehudah has no title, and Shimon’s abbreviated title remains R'; the attestations do not establish one father.
